title: boerhavia diffusa var. vulgaris
intro: Boerhavia diffusa var. vulgaris, commonly known as Red Sage or Pueraria, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Nyctaginaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat a variety of health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Boerhavia diffusa var. vulgaris include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
